Prompt injection risk: untrusted user brief/details are embedded into the prompt sent to the current Copilot conversation via session.send() (USER_DATA_JSON). The only guard is additional prompt text, so crafted brief/details could still steer the model to ignore session/repo instructions and attempt high-impact actions. File step: request-prototype-creation builds and sends the prompt. ---

To fix this without changing intended functionality, keep sending the user’s brief/details but **sanitize and neutralize prompt-control patterns** before embedding them in USER_DATA_JSON. This reduces the chance that user content is interpreted as instructions while preserving semantic content for prototype generation.

Best single fix in this file:

  • Add a local sanitizer function that:
    • Normalizes text.
    • Removes control characters.
    • Neutralizes high-risk instruction tokens/patterns (e.g., “ignore previous instructions”, “system:”, “assistant:”, tool/action command phrases) by inserting zero-width separators so meaning remains readable but less executable as directives.
  • Use sanitized values for brief and details in the JSON payload sent to session.send().
  • Keep existing validation and policy text unchanged.

    • Edits are only in .github/extensions/replica-prototype/request-prototype-creation/index.mjs:

    • Insert helper functions above requestPrototypeCreation.
    • Replace the prompt payload construction lines to use sanitized fields.
